title: Restricted cohomology leg naturality
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ an inverse diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $F_i$ be abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] on $D_i$, with inverse-image coefficient transitions $\varphi_f:D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^*F_i\to F_j$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let $c$ be a cone on $D$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], $G:I\to\operatorname{Ab}(c.pt_{\acute et})$ a functor, and $eG_i:G_i\cong c_i^*F_i$ isomorphisms such that $G(f)$ is $eG_i$, followed by the canonical inverse-image composition comparison and $c_j^*\varphi_f$, followed by $eG_j^{-1}$. Let $L$ be a cocone on $G$. Fix a scheme $X$, an index $i_0\in I$, a morphism $g_0:D_{i_0}\to X$, and an open $W\subseteq X$. Put $J=I_{\ge i_0}$ and $W_j=(D(j\to i_0);g_0)^{-1}W$. For $f:j\to k$ in $J$, restrict $D(f^{\mathrm{op}})$ to $W_k\to W_j$. The coefficient map is the inverse-image composition comparison across this commuting restriction square followed by restriction of $\varphi_f$. For $n\in\mathbb N$, let $T_W^n(f)$ be cohomology pullback along this restricted scheme map followed by cohomology of the coefficient map [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Put $W_L=(c_{i_0};g_0)^{-1}W$. Let $\lambda_W^n(j)$ be cohomology pullback along the restricted projection $W_L\to W_j$, followed by cohomology of the inverse-image square coefficient map formed from $eG_j^{-1}\mathbin{;}L_j$. Then for every $f:j\to k$, $T_W^n(f)\mathbin{;}\lambda_W^n(k)=\lambda_W^n(j)$. No identity or composition equations for $\varphi$ are assumed.

source.place: Tag 01F7, cohomology-equation-functorial and functoriality in the coefficient map; the coherent system in etale-cohomology.tex Tag 09YQ (theorem-colimit) supplies the application, not additional hypotheses.

proof.text: Precompose L.w by eG_j.inv and substitute hG. Cancel eG inverses to obtain the original coefficient leg equation. Restrict along the limit-open inclusion. The cone equation proves restricted projection composition after cancelling the stage-open inclusion. Naturality and vertical pasting identify the restricted transition square followed by the projection square with the projection square at j. Apply cohomology pullback composition, coefficient naturality and H.map composition to get the required equality. Empty opens and zero coefficients require no extra assumptions.

theorem tailOpenCohomologyCoconeLeg_naturality
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (i₀ : I) (g₀ : D.obj (op i₀) ⟶ X) (W : X.Opens) (n : ℕ)
    (j k : Set.Ici i₀) (f : j ⟶ k) :
    tailOpenCohomologyArrow D g₀ W F φ n f ≫
      tailOpenCohomologyCoconeLeg D c g₀ W F G eG L n k =
      tailOpenCohomologyCoconeLeg D c g₀ W F G eG L n j
